dates.name: Utah Jazz vs. Grizzlies — NBA Basketball
dates.desc: Mid-season NBA action at Delta Center. Fast-paced basketball with excellent crowd energy. Perfect evening date to catch live professional sports in a world-class arena.
dates.where: Delta Center — 301 S Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: First Thursday Gallery Stroll + Gateway District Dinner
dates.desc: Monthly First Thursday art walk features free gallery openings, artist meet-and-greets, and complimentary refreshments across downtown SLC galleries (6-9 PM). Afterward, stroll The Gateway district and grab dinner at one of the many restaurants, dessert spots, or breweries. Lively evening vibe.
dates.where: Downtown Salt Lake City galleries + The Gateway — 18 S W Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: The Phantom of the Opera — Eccles Theater
dates.desc: Broadway's legendary musical returns in a revitalized new production. Andrew Lloyd Webber's masterpiece features haunting music, stunning staging, and incredible performances. Runs through April 26. A theatrical experience that rivals any major city.
dates.where: Eccles Theater — 131 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Tulip Festival at Thanksgiving Point — Lehi (Day Trip)
dates.desc: Over one million tulips and spring flowers in full bloom across 50 acres. Stunning photography spots, curated art installations, live entertainment, food trucks, and gardens. Plan 2-3 hours, then enjoy a farm-to-table dinner in Park City (nearby). Peak spring beauty.
dates.where: Thanksgiving Point — 3900 N. Garden Drive, Lehi, UT 84048 (20 min from SLC)

dates.name: Dinner at Tupelo Park City + Historic Main Street Stroll
dates.desc: Chef Matt Harris's celebrated farm-to-table restaurant with fresh Idaho trout, Utah lamb, and housemade pasta in an intimate, sophisticated setting. After dinner, walk Park City's historic Main Street for dessert, galleries, or nightlife. Mountain town elegance.
dates.where: Tupelo Park City — 1375 Park Ave, Park City, UT 84060 (45 min from SLC)

dates.name: Escape Room Challenge + Salt Lake City Brewery Tour
dates.desc: Start downtown with a thrilling 60-minute escape room at Getout Games (Egyptian Tomb, Heist, or Reactor theme). Then head to City Brew Tours for a 2-hour guided brewery experience with beer samples and food pairings at 3-4 local craft breweries. Competitive and fun.
dates.where: Getout Games (202 W 400 S) + City Brew Tours (downtown SLC)

dates.name: Utah Jazz vs. Opponents — NBA Basketball
dates.desc: Another chance to catch Jazz home action at Delta Center. Late April basketball has playoff intensity with high-energy crowds. Grab dinner or drinks pre/post-game in downtown SLC.
dates.where: Delta Center — 301 S Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Park City Spring Day: Hiking + Main Street + Fine Dining
dates.desc: Morning hike to scenic views around Park City (Greens Fork Trail or Bonanza Park Trail — moderate, 4-6 miles with Wasatch views). Lunch and gallery browsing on historic Main Street. Evening dinner at Riverhorse or local favorite, then nightlife or dessert. Complete mountain day.
dates.where: Park City area trails + Park City Historic Main Street + restaurants (45 min from SLC)

dates.name: Utah Symphony — 'The Film Music of Bernard Herrmann'
dates.desc: Conducted by David Robertson at Abravanel Hall. A sophisticated evening of beloved film scores from Bernard Herrmann (Psycho, Vertigo, North by Northwest). Immersive classical music experience in one of the nation's finest concert halls.
dates.where: Abravanel Hall — 123 W South Temple, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Bonneville Shoreline Trail to Ensign Peak — Salt Lake City Foothills
dates.desc: Moderate 6.5-mile loop (or shorter 3-4 mile option) with steady climbing to Ensign Peak and 360-degree views of the Salt Lake Valley, Great Salt Lake, Oquirrh Mountains, and Wasatch Range. Spring wildflowers line the trail in late April. Less crowded than popular downtown trails.
dates.where: Tunnel Springs Trailhead — North Salt Lake, UT (30 min from downtown SLC)

dates.name: Antelope Island State Park — Spring Wildlife & Wildflower Drive
dates.desc: April brings early wildflower blooms across the sagebrush. Drive the scenic loop road and stop for short hikes to see native bison, pronghorn antelope, and bighorn sheep. Sunset views of the Great Salt Lake are stunning. Pack a picnic and stay for golden hour.
dates.where: Antelope Island State Park — 4528 W 1700 S, Syracuse, UT 84075 (35 min from SLC)

dates.name: Snowbird Aerial Tram — High Alpine Spring Views
dates.desc: Ride the aerial tramway 2,000 feet up to Hidden Peak (11,000 ft) for sweeping views of the Wasatch Mountains and beyond. Spring conditions bring melting snow, fresh air, and crisp mountain light. Walk easy summit trails, enjoy the restaurant, or simply take in the vistas.
dates.where: Snowbird Resort — 9385 E Snowbird Tram Rd, Snowbird, UT 84092 (45 min from SLC)

dates.name: Dinner at Tupelo Park City — Globally-Inspired Fine Dining
dates.desc: Chef Matt Harris's celebrated farm-to-table restaurant showcasing artisanal ingredients: fresh Idaho trout, natural Utah lamb, heirloom grains, and housemade pasta. Sophisticated atmosphere with carefully curated wine pairings. Reservations essential.
dates.where: Tupelo Park City — 1375 Park Ave, Park City, UT 84060

dates.name: City Brew Tours — Guided Brewery Experience with Food Pairings
dates.desc: 2-3 hour guided tour of 3-4 Salt Lake craft breweries (Uinta, Salt Fire, Hopkins, Level Crossing, or others). Includes up to 12 beer samples, food pairings or snack, and insider knowledge from expert guides. Great for beer lovers and foodies. Downtown location, easy walking between stops.
dates.where: Downtown Salt Lake City (various breweries)

dates.name: Park City Historic Main Street — Explore, Shop & Dine
dates.desc: Walkable historic district with local galleries, shops, and diverse restaurants (fine dining, casual, sushi, pizza). Grab coffee at a local café, browse art, enjoy live music on weekends, or relax at outdoor patios. Spring weather makes it perfect for leisurely afternoon.
dates.where: Park City Historic Main Street — Park City, UT (45 min from SLC)

dates.name: Utah's Hogle Zoo — Spring Wildlife Afternoon
dates.desc: Walk through exhibits featuring polar bears, big cats, primates, birds, and exotic animals. Spring is a great season with moderate temperatures. See the animals more active in cooler weather. Gift shop and concessions available. Family-friendly and easy-paced.
dates.where: Utah's Hogle Zoo — 2600 Sunnyside Ave, Salt Lake City, UT 84108

dates.name: Spring Wildflower Walk — Bonneville Shoreline Trail Section
dates.desc: Easy 2-3 mile walk along a scenic foothills section of the Bonneville Shoreline Trail with spring wildflowers in bloom. Less strenuous than the full Ensign Peak loop. Perfect for a casual morning or evening date with great views and minimal effort.
dates.where: Bonneville Shoreline Trail trailheads (various locations in SLC foothills)

dates.name: The Phantom of the Opera — Eccles Theater
dates.desc: Broadway's longest-running musical returns in a brand-new production by Cameron Mackintosh. Stunning staging, incredible performances, and the unforgettable Andrew Lloyd Webber score. Runs through April 26.
dates.where: Eccles Theater — 131 S Main St, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Clark Planetarium + The Gateway District
dates.desc: Free interactive science museum with immersive planetarium dome shows and space exhibits. Then explore The Gateway district for shopping, art installations, restaurants, and dessert. Full-dome IMAX experiences (book in advance) are spectacular.
dates.where: Clark Planetarium — 110 S 400 W, Salt Lake City, UT 84101

dates.name: Escape Room Challenge at Getout Games — Salt Lake City
dates.desc: Four themed escape rooms downtown: Egyptian Tomb, Zombie on a Chain, The Heist, or Reactor Room. 60 minutes to solve puzzles and escape under pressure. Book in advance; evening and weekend slots available. Tests your problem-solving as a team.
dates.where: Getout Games — 202 W 400 S, Salt Lake City, UT 84101
